lines.en: Ross, do you realize this is the first time in my life
I'm doing something I actually care about?
This is the first time in my life
I'm doing something that I'm actually good at?
I mean, if you don't get that...
No, hey, I get that, okay?
I get that big time, and I'm happy for you,
but I'm tired of having a relationship
I don't know what to do anymore.
I cannot keep having this same fight
No, you're making this too hard.
Oh, I'm making this too hard.
Okay, what do you want me to do?
Look, maybe we should just take a break.
Let's get some frozen yogurt or something.
